name: Adult Copper Dragon
summary: A huge metallic dragon that breathes acid or slowing gas, casts trickster spells, and takes legendary actions.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.text: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) Slowing Breath or (B) Spellcasting to cast *{ref:spell/mind-spike}* (level 4 version).

actions.name: Slowing Breath
actions.onFailure: The target can't take Reactions; its {ref:glossary/speed} is halved; and it can take either an action or a {ref:glossary/bonus-action} on its turn, not both. This effect lasts until the end of its next turn.

atWill.note: Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell

legendaryActions.intro: Immediately after another creature's turn, the dragon can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The dragon regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

items.name: Giggling Magic

save.targets: one creature the dragon can see within 90 feet

items.onFailure: Until the end of its next turn, the target rolls 1d6 whenever it makes an ability check or attack roll and subtracts the number rolled from the {ref:glossary/d20-test}.
items.onFailureOrSuccess: The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

items.name: Mind Jolt
items.text: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast *{ref:spell/mind-spike}* (level 4 version). The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

items.name: Pounce
items.text: The dragon moves up to half its {ref:glossary/speed}, and it makes one Rend attack.
